mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies tonight with a temperature of seventy-two degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. We have a waxing crescent moon tonight, and there are no visible passes of the International Space Station scheduled.

In city updates, Verona is highlighting sustainable transportation efforts. The city was recognized as a Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community in January of twenty-twenty-four, thanks to ongoing infrastructure improvements and police safety programs.
For local events, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard on July seventeenth, or visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July twenty-second.

In the police department's weekly recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Friday, July tenth, at Old PB and Whalen Road, resulting in minor injuries to the cyclist and a citation for the driver.
Wrapping up with Culver's, today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl, and tomorrow's will be Mint Cookie. The restaurant is currently closed and will open at ten a.m.
